ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels, with black pixels occupying approximately 95% of the visible fluke surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) pigmentation across both lobes. High-contrast white pixel clusters are isolated at the distal tips of both lobes and in specific linear/circular patterns on the inner right lobe and mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a narrow acute angle at the vertex and significant vertical depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with irregular pixel-amplitude; trailing edge displays jagged peaks and valleys from the median notch to the outer tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the posterior trailing edge, curving toward the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters located at the terminal ends of both the left and right fluke tips, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible on the inner right lobe as a series of bright white, intersecting parallel linear marks (rake marks) that create a high-contrast disruption against the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant rake mark trauma on the medial right lobe; extensive calcified scarring or barnacle clusters at the fluke extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique intersecting 'H' or 'X' geometric scar pattern located on the right lobe adjacent to the median notch.
